subject: Site Engineer, Gympie, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the Site Engineer role in Gympie advertised on SEEK, and sending my resume and cover letter to this address as the ad asks.

I'm a civil engineering graduate (BSCE, 2019) who finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia in February 2026. My site experience is from the Philippines, April 2019 to February 2020: project-in-charge on a community hall renovation, coordinating 10 to 15 workers a day, then field engineer on subdivision finishing works. The day-to-day was inspections, quality and safety checks, reviewing drawings, tracking procurement and materials, and writing site reports, which lines up with the quality, procurement and documentation side of your role. I haven't worked on sewer projects, and my Australian experience is the diploma, so I'd be learning your systems, your Southside Sewerage work and the local standards on the job.

I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria, available for regional work, and open to discussing relocation to Gympie.

My drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd welcome a phone conversation.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

Careers page: 'You can apply directly through our website by uploading your resume on the Careers page, or check our listings on platforms like SEEK for specific vacancies.' Advert also states OCE will provide a vehicle, role is based at the Gympie office, and prior water/sewer experience is highly desirable. Search/fetch budget used: 4 WebSearch, 7 WebFetch.
